paragraphs.zh: Herbizides Mittel, umfassend die thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation von Tembotrione gemäß einem der Ansprüche 1 bis 7 und eine metastabile Kristallmodifikation oder ein Gemisch der metastabilen Kristallmodifikationen von Tembotrione, dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass das Mittel mehr als 80 Gew.-% der stabilen Kristallmodifikation enthält.
paragraphs.en: Herbicidal agent, comprising the thermodynamically stable crystal modification of tembotrione according to any one of claims 1 to 7 and a metastable crystal modification or a mixture of the metastable crystal modifications of tembotrione, characterised in that the agent contains more than 80 Gew.-% (percent by weight) of the stable crystal modification.
paragraphs.notes: MARKER NOTE: the claims carry no [00NN] paragraph markers, so the claim number as printed ('12.') is used as the marker, as instructed. DEPENDENCY: 'gemäß einem der Ansprüche 1 bis 7' (according to any one of claims 1 to 7); it names no other claim. 'Gew.-%' is transcribed exactly as printed, with the hyphen between 'Gew.' and '%'. '80' is printed without a decimal comma. The phrase 'dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass' is set in bold on the page; the bold is typographic emphasis of the characterising clause and is not marked up in the zh text. Reassembled across a line break: none in this claim; every line break falls at a space.

paragraphs.zh: Verwendung der thermodynamisch stabilen Kristallmodifikation von Tembotrione gemäß einem der Ansprüche 1 bis 7 oder eines Mittels gemäß Anspruch 11 oder 12 zur Bekämpfung von unerwünschten Pflanzen.
paragraphs.en: Use of the thermodynamically stable crystal modification of tembotrione according to any one of claims 1 to 7, or of an agent according to claim 11 or 12, for controlling unwanted plants.
paragraphs.notes: MARKER NOTE: claim number used as the marker, as instructed. DEPENDENCY: two references, printed separately and joined by 'oder' - 'gemäß einem der Ansprüche 1 bis 7' for the crystal modification, and 'gemäß Anspruch 11 oder 12' for the agent. Claim 11 is not printed on this page; it is on the preceding page.

paragraphs.zh: Verfahren zur Bekämpfung von unerwünschten Pflanzen, dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass man die thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation von Tembotrione gemäß einem der Ansprüche 1 bis 7 oder ein Mittel gemäß Anspruch 11 oder 12 auf die unerwünschten Pflanzen und/oder ihren Lebensraum einwirken lässt.
paragraphs.en: Method for controlling unwanted plants, characterised in that the thermodynamically stable crystal modification of tembotrione according to any one of claims 1 to 7, or an agent according to claim 11 or 12, is allowed to act on the unwanted plants and/or their habitat.
paragraphs.notes: MARKER NOTE: claim number used as the marker, as instructed. DEPENDENCY: as in claim 13, two references joined by 'oder' - 'gemäß einem der Ansprüche 1 bis 7' and 'gemäß Anspruch 11 oder 12'. Reassembled across a line break: 'thermodyna-misch' at the end of the first printed line is one word, 'thermodynamisch'; the hyphen there is typographic and is not part of the word. 'dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass' is set in bold on the page; the bold is not marked up in the zh text.

paragraphs.zh: Verfahren nach Anspruch 14 zur Bekämpfung von Schadpflanzen in monokotylen Pflanzenkulturen.
paragraphs.en: Method according to claim 14 for controlling harmful plants (weeds) in monocotyledonous crops.
paragraphs.notes: MARKER NOTE: claim number used as the marker, as instructed. DEPENDENCY: 'nach Anspruch 14' (according to claim 14), a single reference. 'Schadpflanzen' is translated literally as 'harmful plants'; the ordinary agronomic reading is 'weeds' and both are given, per the instruction to translate literally where the term could be read two ways.

paragraphs.zh: Verfahren nach Anspruch 14 oder 15, worin die Pflanzenkulturen gentechnisch verändert oder durch Mutationsselektion erhalten sind.
paragraphs.en: Method according to claim 14 or 15, wherein the crops are genetically modified or have been obtained by mutation selection.
paragraphs.notes: MARKER NOTE: claim number used as the marker, as instructed. DEPENDENCY: 'nach Anspruch 14 oder 15' (according to claim 14 or 15). Reassembled across a line break: 'Mutationsse-lektion' at the end of the first printed line is one word, 'Mutationsselektion'; the hyphen there is typographic and is not part of the word. This is the last claim of the patent and the last text on the page.
